long_summary: The document provides biographies of HealthRate's leadership team. Tom Sherrard is the EVP of Sale & Market Development, responsible for client acquisition and market expansion, with over 17 years of experience in product, sales, operations, and client management. Jeff Sage serves as Chief Product Officer (also CTO and co‑founder), bringing more than 25 years of healthcare IT experience. Tim Michaels is the Founder and CEO, possessing over 30 years in healthcare risk management, analytics, and software development. Each profile includes contact information (phone and email) and a summary of their professional background.
